mean-median-pull.alt: Two dotplots of battery life in hours on a scale from 7 to 15. Top: eleven phones from 7.2 to 10.6 hours, with median 9.30 and mean 9.21 close together. Bottom: the same phones plus one that lasts 14.9 hours; the median moves only to 9.40 while the mean moves to 9.68, pulled toward the large value.
